author: JOHN_CENAAAAAAAA
body:
Dear Avicus users,
The staff team and Senior staff team has been noticing a lot of complaints regarding our staff team as well as our very community, which is by all means something we would like to fix very fast.  Therefore, Fluenza_ and I have created two surveys for your feedback and opinion on how we can improve our systems for this batch of staff apps and for our community in general.

Please take the surveys here:
http://goo.gl/8pLbj7
http://goo.gl/OkeJux

Again, we genuinely appreciate your opinion on this.  Be honest, all answers are anonymous.  However, if we learn you have been trolling the survey then you will be punished accordingly. 
 
Thanks again,
-The Avicus Staff/Senior Staff Team
